normalized_matching_profile.description: Must be at least 25 years of age to rent this property. 126 Tropical Breeze – Modern Coastal Retreat on 30A 6-seater LSV Brought to you by Beach Blue Properties Welcome to 126 Tropical Breeze, a spacious 4-bedroom, 3-bath coastal escape located just one mile from the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters of Scenic 30A. This modern beach retreat offers over 2,700 square feet of beautifully designed living space, comfortably accommodating up to 20 guests. Perfect for family gatherings or group getaways, our home combines modern style with coastal comfort. Step inside to an open-concept floor plan filled with natural light and clean coastal décor. The spacious kitchen features a large panty and second refrigerator and is equipped with all the cookware and dinnerware needed to prepare a gourmet meal The dining area offers seating for 6 and bar seating for 10, while the adjoining living area features an oversized sectional and a 65” Smart Tv, The primary suite features a luxurious king bed and spa-inspired ensuite bath complete with soaking tub, walk-in shower, and dual vanity. Two guest rooms — one with a Queen bed, the other with two Doubles — share a full bathroom with a tub/shower combo. Upstairs, kids and teens will love their private bunk room featuring three full-over-full bunk beds, a 65” SMART TV, and its own full bath. Outdoor living is just as inviting. Fire up the propane grill for dinner al fresco or catch a game on the 42” TV in the covered patio area. Guests also enjoy access to your very own 6-seater LSV, making it easy to explore nearby beaches, dining, and entertainment. There’s parking for up to five vehicles, a full-size washer and dryer, and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the home. Location Highlights: Tropical Breeze sits just minutes from some of 30A’s favorite destinations. Head west to Gulf Place for casual dining and live music, or explore Blue Mountain Beach, known for its local charm, laid-back cafés, and artisan ice cream. Venture a bit east to Grayton Beach State Park, Seaside, and WaterColor for boutique shopping, wine bars, and scenic coastal trails. Popular nearby restaurants include Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar, The Perfect Pig, and Blue Mabel Smokehouse — all just a quick LSV ride away. Guests will also enjoy a beach gear rental credit, allowing you to choose from bikes, paddle boards, kayaks, and more, delivered right to your door. Why You’ll Love It 4 Bedrooms • 3 Bathrooms • Sleeps 20 6-Seater LSV Included Pet Friendly (one small dog under 25 lbs with a $300 pet fee) Smart TVs in living area and bunk room Two refrigerators + fully stocked kitchen Outdoor living area with grill and TV Complimentary beach gear rental credit Less than 1 mile to beach access Whether you’re here for a week of sun and sand, family time, or exploring the best of 30A, 126 Tropical Breeze offers the perfect balance of comfort, convenience, and coastal style!
